approach: Balance the knot vertically and horizontally to find all three string tensions, then check whether any of them actually comes out zero.

steps.text: At the knot, three strings pull: A straight down carrying the 10 kg block, B up to the ceiling at 30° from the vertical, and C straight toward the wall (horizontal).
Balance the vertical direction; only T(A) and the vertical part of T(B) act vertically.
Balance the horizontal direction; only T(C) and the horizontal part of T(B) act horizontally.
All three tensions come out clearly positive, so none of the strings carries zero tension.

common_mistakes.text: Assuming a horizontal string like C carries no load since it does not hold up any weight directly, missing that it must balance the horizontal pull of the angled string B.
